blocks.text: Eval rubric: Lakeshore category copy and title pattern

This is the working cut for LSH-EVAL-2025-011 on February 20, 2025. Nia Brooks asked for a written bound after the current path (Uneven contractor copy, 22 collection pages) stopped being honest. I am Michael Gilfilian, Web Developer, writing for Luis Ortega, Cole Brennan, and Mara Singh. Primary host seo.lakeshore.internal. If you are skimming, jump the decision callout, then the refuse on city name in every H1, then open questions. If you are implementing next week, jump the constraints, the numbers table, and the commands or contracts.

Title: product, then category, then store only on local landing pages. Collection H1 is category, not city. Fail if keyword density is a scoring trick. I am not restating a hallway yes. city name in every H1 is out because Four stores would rank for each other. Nia already paid that tax at Harbor. Do not import it. Cost of doing nothing is already in the numbers: look at pages=22, stores=4, density=2.8, weeks=2, fail=1, local=4, h1=1, contractor=1. Sibling tickets LSH-5670 and LSH-ADR-2024-029.
